## Automatically Generated Layout Pages

- Layout pages are created automatically based on the drawings are in the project. These pages can the following drawings:

    - Plan
    - Elevation
    - Section
    - 3D View
    - Step Details

<VideoPlayer src="/video/stair/arms.mp4" />

- Each layout page includes a project title received from save name, an automatically created date and who created based on the MAC adress of the computer. 

<VideoPlayer src="/video/stair/arms.mp4" />
